entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: To use your ability, press SPACE. Each character has a unique ability and there will be a "Bonus Input" you can perform to make your ability more effective.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: For example, Miku's "Bonus Input" is a small rythm game, the more accurate you press, the more damage she will deal!

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I don't need someone to tell me what I can or can't do.

entries.speaker: Lyoo
entries.text: Then go ahead and try clanker

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: WHAT DID YOU JUST CALL ME-
